title: tpu-sharding Result
description: Output deliverable for the tpu-sharding orchestrator agent.

status.description: Outcome of the sharding study. Measurement and winning artifact fields are owed by 'completed' alone.

summary.description: Summary of findings, improvements achieved, and overall trajectory highlights.

total_runs.description: Total number of experiment runs executed during the session.

state_artifact.description: Relative artifact path to state.json ledger (e.g., 'state.json').

best_run.description: Details of the best performing run achieved. Omitted if all runs failed.

iteration.description: Iteration index of the best run.

unit.description: Canonical unit ('s' for all time/latency metrics, '%' for percentages, 'GiB'/'GB' for memory, 'GiB/s'/'GB/s' for bandwidth, 'TFLOPS/s/device' for compute, throughput units, or '' for dimensionless/custom dimensions).

recipe_path.description: Relative artifact path to winning recipe script/config.

report_path.description: Relative artifact path to winning run report.

best_recipe_artifact.description: Convenience path to the winning recipe artifact (e.g., '3/recipe_3.sh').

best_report_artifact.description: Convenience path to the winning run report artifact (e.g., '3/report_3.md').

failure_reason.description: Diagnostic reason or failure description when status is not 'completed'.

error_message.description: Detailed error diagnostic or stack trace when status is not 'completed'.

examples.summary: Completed 5 optimization rounds. Best configuration at Run 3 achieved 45.2% MFU (up from 39.5% baseline) via ep=4, tp=4, and Splash attention.
